Log__desc: If true, prints [FearTheFire] debug/status lines to the server console.
ThrownTorchFleeChance__desc: Chance [0..1] that a thrown/dropped torch near an animal forces flee & removes firebrave.
ThrownTorchCooldownSeconds__desc: Cooldown seconds per animal before another thrown-torch can trigger.
FirepitFearRadius__desc: Horizontal meters to check around the animal for lit firepits.
FirepitScanIntervalSeconds__desc: How often (seconds) each animal scans for lit firepits.
FirepitsIgnoreFirebrave__desc: If true, even firebrave animals flee from lit firepits.
FirepitBlockCodes__desc: Block code substrings considered a *lit* firepit (match against Block.Code.Path).
FearDurationSeconds__desc: Seconds the fear from fire effect lasts once triggered.
DetectionRadius__desc: Meters around a torch-like player to scan and attach FearTheFire behavior to nearby wolves/bears. Can affect performance depending on numbers of entities and players
BearTooCloseAttack__desc: min distance attack for a bear to attack you when he has vigilant behavior
WolfStayMin__desc: min distance for vanilla StayInRange when manual orbit cannot start.
WolfStayMax__desc: max distance for vanilla StayInRange when manual orbit cannot start.
WolfOrbitMin__desc: Preferred orbit inner radius (m) while the wolf is ‘staying close’.
WolfOrbitMax__desc: Preferred orbit outer radius (m) while the wolf is ‘staying close’.
OrbitMoveSpeed__desc: Movement speed used wolf is orbiting a player (roughly a run speed).
OrbitRetargetMin__desc: Minimum seconds between wolf orbit retarget picks.
OrbitRetargetMax__desc: Maximum seconds between wolf orbit retarget picks.
MaxChaseDistance__desc: If the player is farther than this, wolves stop orbiting until re-engaged.
AllowFirebrave__desc: If true, animals can become ‘firebrave’ (ignore torches) after the timer or certain triggers.
BearProbIdleWatch__desc: Probability [0..1] that a bear chooses IdleWatch when torch effect begins.
BearProbAttackAnyway__desc: Probability [0..1] that a bear takes the ‘attacks anyway’ branch (becomes firebrave if allowed).
BearProbFlee__desc: Probability [0..1] that a bear flees when torch effect begins.
WolfProbStayClose__desc: Probability [0..1] that a wolf chooses StayClose (manual orbit).
WolfProbFlee__desc: Probability [0..1] that a wolf flees when torch effect begins.
